Hero.title: Fit met Levi
Hero.body: I’m Levi Otte, and I help you live healthier at a pace that fits your life.

Goals.title: What do you want for yourself right now?
Goals.intro: Pick what fits today. No mandatory track, no guaranteed numbers.

gewichtsverlies.title: Weight & balance
gewichtsverlies.short: Eat more calmly, move more clearly.
gewichtsverlies.body: You don’t need to crash. We look at food and movement you can keep — without promised kilos.

spiermassa.title: Muscle
spiermassa.body: Getting stronger can stay calm. You get a rhythm you can keep, not endless gym days.

vitaliteit.title: Vitality
vitaliteit.body: More energy in ordinary days: sleep, food, a mind that cooperates. No trick.

How.title: Rather talk first?
How.intro: That’s fine. A FitCheck is a short, no-obligation conversation.

steps.title: You say where you are
steps.body: Your name, mobile, and what you want. An extra sentence is welcome — not required.

steps.title: I get in touch
steps.body: No chatbot. A message or a call, to hear how your days actually run.

steps.title: We look together
steps.body: You get a first direction. Lifestyle coaching — not medical advice, not an obligation.

About.homeBody: I’m {name}. If you want to feel healthier and calmer in your body, I walk with you — with food doing most of the work, training you can keep, and a mind that stays.
About.homeDisclosure: In person, outdoors, or online, by appointment. I’m an independent Herbalife member; this site belongs to Fit met Levi, not Herbalife.
About.pageLead: Personal coach in {city}, Belgium. Since {year}. Google {rating}.
About.p1: If you want to keep going in a healthy, motivated way, it helps to know what you actually need. Food, movement, and mindset work better together than training harder on its own. I’ve been refining that approach since 2015 — not with hype, but with a rhythm you can keep.
About.p2: Coaching can happen in person in Roosdaal, outdoors, or online, always by appointment.
About.p3: I’m an independent Herbalife member. This website belongs to Fit met Levi / Levi Otte, not the official Herbalife site. No income claims, no medical claims.

items.a: A short, no-obligation conversation. You leave your name, mobile, and goal. I get in touch, and we see whether coaching makes sense. Lifestyle coaching, not a medical exam.
The FitCheck itself is free. After that we discuss whether and how to continue. No hidden enrolment through this form.

items.q: Do I already need to train?
items.a: No. Whether you’re starting again or you’ve trained for years: we begin where you are.
Yes. Coaching can be in person in Roosdaal, outdoors, or online — by appointment.
Levi is a self-employed member-coach, not a Herbalife employee. This website belongs to Fit met Levi / Levi Otte, not the official Herbalife site. Products are optional and never an income promise.
No. FitCheck and coaching are not treatment for illness and do not replace a doctor or dietitian. For medical questions, I’ll point you elsewhere.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.p2: Through the FitCheck form I collect first and last name, mobile number, chosen goal, and optionally a message. Purpose: to contact you about lifestyle coaching. Legal basis: your request (pre-contractual steps / legitimate interest in answering).
Privacy.p3: Data does not go to a public newsletter. FitCheck requests are emailed to {email} for as long as the conversation runs, then deleted or limited to what accounting or a dispute requires.
Privacy.p4: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, and complaint to the Belgian Data Protection Authority. Send a message via the number above.
Privacy.p5: This site is not an official Herbalife website. Levi Otte is an independent member. No payment-card data is collected through FitCheck.
